name: Vera Browser Connector BETA
summary: Share one dedicated housing-search tab with your approved Vera Browser Gateway.
detailedDescription: THIS EXTENSION IS FOR BETA TESTING. An approved Vera tester signs in to Vera and chooses Connect this browser once for that Chrome profile. Connecting does not share any tab. Vera may process the URL and observed housing-listing content from exactly one dedicated tab only after the tester separately chooses Share this tab with Vera. The connector does not sign in, type credentials, solve CAPTCHA, contact anyone, submit applications, make payments, upload, download, or run background searches. Unsharing immediately stops future tab access. Revoking browser access clears the device connection, and the tester can reconnect only through the approved Vera account flow.
